bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for University of Minnesota operations and maintenance.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE.

$796,544,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $796,544,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota for operations and maintenance of the University of Minnesota.
